data_notes: Prerequisite groups preserve AND/OR relationships. Within a group, condition 'all_of' means every listed item is required; 'any_of' means one listed item is sufficient.
Prerequisite course titles and descriptions are included when they were available in the supplied text. Values are null when the supplied text did not include that course's title or description.
Credit or concurrent registration is represented with credit_or_concurrent_registration: true.
Non-course conditions such as class standing, admission, placement tests, or department approval are stored in prerequisites.non_course_requirements.
Credit hours are stored as a number when only one value is given.
Science electives section reflects the requirement to select two courses (8 hours total) from the listed options, including paired lecture+lab combinations.
